title: Launch party: Back To The Egg by Wings | 1979
content:
Wings held a launch party for the Back To The Egg album on 11 June 1979.

The event took place in Studio Two at Abbey Road Studios. The room was decorated in the fried egg theme of the album, with specially-designed tablecloths and parasols on the tables, and rubber hard boiled eggs and egg-themed jigsaw puzzles for the guests.

Around 150 guests attended, and footage from the celebrity-filled ‘Rockestra Theme’ recording session was shown.
